purpose: Small descriptive simulation-budget comparison; not a coverage, safety, deployment or research-enablement acceptance test.

cohorts.name: thermal_jitter
cohorts.generator: thermal_deadtime fixed 12-point anchors, independently multiply T and delay by U(0.9,1.1), retain K=1 and actuator limits

cohorts.name: out_of_zoo
cohorts.generator: all ten existing scenarios, four variants each
cohorts.variant_rule: numerator and one denominator coefficient independently multiplied by 10**U(-0.3,0.3); delay multiplied by U(0.8,1.2); RNG seed adds the existing crc32 scenario offset

head_prior.source: fixed non-oracle assumptions; no plant identification or true transfer-function access

reporting: per-plant actual calls and maximum budget
improvement relative to the shared measured start
worst measured trial cost and any strict cost increase
all failures and divergent costs retained
source, checkpoint, calibration, protocol and raw hashes
interpretation: No fitting, threshold choice, model selection or parameter tuning from these results.
New parameter instances in already known families; not a previously unseen family or independent scientific confirmation.
The fixed starting gains and assumed priors may be poor. This study does not establish benefit with accurate user priors or on arbitrary Simulink models.
Best cost and actual simulation cost must be presented together; fewer calls alone is not superiority.
Returned best-of-measured retention is not safe exploration. All measured trial failures remain in the report.
Per-object numerical mapping and cross-platform bitwise reproduction are not claimed; batch layout and reference environment are recorded.
